title: Golden test exports should include harness_epoch via build_export
description: Golden test exports don't include harness_epoch. The orchestrator adds it when running real games (orchestrator.py line 253), but golden tests use build_export() from scripts/export_game.py which doesn't include it. Rather than reimplementing this in golden_helpers.py, build_export should be the single source of truth and should include the harness epoch in its output. This ensures golden exports match the structure of real game exports.
